en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Compared to the prison...any 
scenery would be nice.

Try and imagine looking around and 
only seeing men trapped in the past.

It's nice to see someone like you 
who looks to the future...

It gives me the foolish idea that 
I can live that way, too...

Do I really look like I'd 
take you up on that?

I thought we'd get along, 
but I guess I was mistaken...

Good idea. That'll help remind me 
that I'm not in prison now.

There, I couldn't dream of just taking 
a walk whenever I felt like it.

It's funny, right? To me, just taking 
a simple walk is extravagant...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Ryoma looks deep in thought...
